Let E be a finite-dimensional real Hilbert space with its Borel structure, including rank zero. Let V be globally C2 and 0<alpha<=beta with alpha||a||²<=D²V(x)[a,a]<=beta||a||² for every x,a. For eta>0 and beta*eta<=1, let mu be the literal normalized volume tilt exp(-V), J the actual law of (X,X+sqrt(eta)G) with independent X~mu and standard Gaussian G, and nu=J.snd. The theorem produces genuine probability of mu,J,nu and common Markov kernels R,S, with R disintegrating swappedJ, every-y S the pushforward of R by x->2x-y and the exact normalized density exp(-V((y+u)/2)-||y-u||²/(8eta)). For every signed globally smooth compactly supported f, Tf(y)=integral f dS(y) is globally differentiable, f,Tf and its true gradient belong to L2(nu), and the actual conditional variance is integrable under nu. Its outer integral equals integral f²dnu-integral(Tf)²dnu. Moreover eta integral||gradientTf||²dnu is at most (1-alphaeta)²/[4(1+alphaeta)] times that same defect. All probability, conditional-law and analytic domains are outputs; no centering of f or extra certificates are assumed.
Exactscope: Smooth compact outer(C.2) exact coefficient and actual conditional variance-defect identity with all probability/measurability/L2/integrability domains internal. theorem reflected_conditional_gradient_energy
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x a : E,
      (α : ℝ) * ‖a‖^2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x a) a ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x a) a ≤ (β : ℝ) * ‖a‖^2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ) * η ≤ 1) :
    let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x)
    let J := Measure.map (fun p : E × E => (p.1, p.1 + Real.sqrt η • p.2))
      (μ.prod (stdGaussian E))
    let ν := J.snd
    IsProbabilityMeasure μ ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure J ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure ν ∧
    ∃ R S : Kernel E E, IsMarkovKernel R ∧ IsMarkovKernel S ∧
      (J.map Prod.swap).IsCondKernel R ∧
      (∀ y, S y = (R y).map (fun x => (2 : ℝ) • x - y)) ∧
      (∀ y, S y = (volume : Measure E).tilted
        (fun u => -V ((1/2 : ℝ) • (y+u)) - ‖y-u‖^2/(8*η))) ∧
      ∀ (f : E → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ f → HasCompactSupport f →
        let Tf := fun y => ∫ u, f u ∂S y
        Differentiable ℝ Tf ∧ MemLp f 2 ν ∧ MemLp Tf 2 ν ∧
        MemLp (gradient Tf) 2 ν ∧
        Integrable (fun y =>
          AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.Poincare.variance
            (S y) f) ν ∧
        (∫ y, AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.Poincare.variance
          (S y) f ∂ν) = (∫ y, (f y)^2 ∂ν) - (∫ y, (Tf y)^2 ∂ν) ∧
        η * (∫ y, ‖gradient Tf y‖^2 ∂ν) ≤
          (1-(α : ℝ)*η)^2/(4*(1+(α : ℝ)*η)) *
            ((∫ y, (f y)^2 ∂ν) - (∫ y, (Tf y)^2 ∂ν))
